status: Reported research result, privacy-edited; later corrections take precedence. Not all calculations were rerun in publication preparation.

data.name: trunk_open
data.confidence: high, vehicle-action-correlated in two open/close cycles
notes: Freshness-gate received state; missing frames do not mean closed.
The direct transitions were aligned to the user's ordered actions, not independent switch timestamps.

data.name: driver_seatbelt_unbuckled_status
data.set_means: unbuckled, as observed in this parked capture
data.clear_means: buckled, as explicitly reported for the start of this capture
data.confidence: high for observed polarity; identity already established in earlier tests
data.new_vs_v05: polarity resolution, not a new field
notes: No evidence here distinguishing raw buckle switch from ECU-derived seatbelt warning/status.
Do not claim every warning/chime behavior is decoded.

data.name: dimmer_level_code
data.confidence: strong working interpretation, raw code not calibrated photometric percentage
data.new_vs_v05: expanded observed range and candidate field split
notes: Do not scale the full byte as 0..255 brightness.
24 is an observed minimum in this test, not a universal endpoint.
Bit split is supported by raw E4 = 80 | 64; interpretation remains provisional.

data.name: dimmer_maximum_override_candidate
notes: Set at the final reported maximum-brightness position only.
Remains set through capture end; no return transition observed.
Not proven whether this denotes a detent, override request, or another related illumination state.
Retain as candidate; do not classify as fully decoded or hide indiscriminately.
